name: Loíza (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Three wavy vertical stripes of green, gold and red, the green hoist charged with the silhouette of a bell tower in yellow, for the church of San Patricio.
history: Loíza is a town and municipality on the northeastern coast of Puerto Rico. The bell tower in the canton represents religious tradition and the historic church of San Patricio.

features.role: bell tower of the church of San Patricio
